#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;

ll lsc[62], rsc[62], rsc2[62];
char s[62];
map<pair<ll,int>,ll> nm, mm;

ll comb(int n, int k) {
    if (n < k || k < 0) return 0;
    ll res = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        res = res * (n - i) / (i + 1);
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    int r, c, n, i, cnta = 0, cntb = 0, ok, ast, bst;
    ll msum = 0, nsum = 0, bsum, rasp = 0;
    scanf("%d%d\n", &r, &c);
    n = 2 * (r + c);
    scanf("%s", s);
    
    lsc[2*r-1] = 1;
    for (i = 2*r; i < n; ++i)
        lsc[i] = lsc[i-1] * i / (1LL * i - 2LL * r + 1LL);
    
    for (i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
        rsc[i] = comb(i, r);
        rsc2[i] = comb(i, r-1);
    }
    
    nsum = rsc[n/2] * rsc[n/2];
    
    for (i = n-1; i >= 0; --i) {
        ok = (msum > 0 || cntb == n/2) && !(cnta == n/2);
        if (ok) {
            cnta++;
            msum -= rsc2[n/2 - cnta] * rsc[n/2 - cntb];
        } else {
            cntb++;
            msum += rsc2[n/2 - cntb] * rsc[n/2 - cnta];
        }
    }
    msum = abs(msum);
    
    mm[{0, 0}] = 1;
    
    for (i = n-1; i >= 2*r-1; --i) {
        nm.clear();
        for (auto& p : mm) {
            ll sum = p.first.first;
            ll ncnt = p.second;
            int cnt = p.first.second;
            ast = n/2 - cnt;
            bst = i + 1 - ast;
            ll asum = sum + rsc2[ast-1] * rsc[bst];
            ll bsum = sum - rsc2[bst-1] * rsc[ast];
            
            if (s[i] == 'A') {
                nm[{asum, cnt+1}] += ncnt;
            } else if (s[i] == 'B') {
                nm[{bsum, cnt}] += ncnt;
            } else {
                nm[{asum, cnt+1}] += ncnt;
                nm[{bsum, cnt}] += ncnt;
            }
        }
        nsum -= lsc[i];
        mm.clear();
        for (auto& p : nm) {
            ll sum = p.first.first;
            ll ncnt = p.second;
            int cnt = p.first.second;
            ast = n/2 - cnt;
            bst = i - ast;
            if (cnt > n/2 || (i - cnt) > n/2) continue;
            if (sum < -msum - rsc[ast]*rsc[bst] || sum > msum + rsc[ast]*rsc[bst]) continue;
            mm[{sum, cnt}] += ncnt;
        }
    }
    
    bsum = 1e18;
    for (auto& p : mm) {
        bsum = min(bsum, abs(p.first.first));
    }
    
    for (auto& p : mm) {
        ll sum = p.first.first;
        ll ncnt = p.second;
        int cnt = p.first.second;
        if (sum == bsum || sum == -bsum) {
            int sem = 0;
            for (i = 0; i < 2*r-1; ++i) {
                if (s[i] == '?') sem++;
                else if (s[i] == 'A') cnt++;
            }
            ncnt *= comb(sem, n/2 - cnt);
            rasp += ncnt;
        }
    }
    
    printf("%lld\n", rasp);
    return 0;
}
